analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (104,650 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (108,952/107,731/107,321 KRW): Below mid-term MAs, short-term trend weakening.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (115,766/94,621 KRW): Approaching long-term support, confirming downside rigidity.
· 52-week position (60.7%) + Current price level nearing historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (54.1→45.3): Entering oversold, suggesting rebound potential.
· MACD histogram trajectory (706.6509→15.5814): Weakness persists, no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 102,099 KRW): Approaching lower band, support expected.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (101,485 KRW): Based on Pivot S1 (98,845 KRW) and 20-day low (100,885 KRW).
· Swing resistance (111,355 KRW): Breakout expected to signal short-term trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low forming): Potential recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.07x vs 5-day avg): Normal level, moderate confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Buy consideration possible due to RSI entering oversold and potential Higher Low pattern, but maintaining wait-and-see due to ADX no trend and persistent MACD weakness.
